turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My cat keeps scratching the furniture and I'm trying to pick a fix.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hear me out on all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is a really tall scratching post right next to the couch.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is putting sticky tape on the arms of the sofa so she hates touching it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could get those soft caps that go over her claws, which last about a month.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The tall scratching post is the best long term fix, since it gives her a place she's allowed to scratch. The sticky tape works well alongside it to steer her away from the couch. The soft caps work, but you'd have to keep putting them back on.
